purpose: Test the only untried outcome-blind concurrency boundary between V168's always-active all-or-none heavy-terminal rejection and V170's activation at three or more heavy terminal players: activate the unchanged V168 guard at two or more current heavy players while retaining exact V159 behavior at zero or one.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

frozen_evidence.v175_disposition: all six valid runs retained; request-cohort active admission retired; remaining fourteen unauthorized

causal_diagnosis.supported: V170 is the strongest complete twenty-seed candidate: it passes throughput mean and paired gates and misses only QPR mean by 0.0003683327936042369. V168 proves that stronger all-or-none rejection can raise QPR above OCS, but applying it at every positive heavy count loses two throughput paired wins. V171 through V175 all admit heavy players in active windows and fail to improve the joint gates. The untested causal midpoint is therefore the V168 all-or-none rejection itself with activation moved from V170's minimum count three to minimum count two; it introduces no active heavy admission and changes only the current outcome-blind concurrency boundary.

single_mechanism_change_from_v170.old_activation_rule: activate exact V168 all-or-none CPU guard when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than two
single_mechanism_change_from_v170.new_activation_rule: activate exact V168 all-or-none CPU guard when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than one
single_mechanism_change_from_v170.inactive_rule: exact V159 terminal admission when current heavy count is zero or one
single_mechanism_change_from_v170.active_rule: reject every current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player and admit no such heavy player
